content: The benefits of using this medication are considered to outweigh the potential risks of side effects. In rare cases, it has been associated with severe and potentially fatal worsening of breathing problems or asthma, a condition known as paradoxical bronchospasm. Serious allergic reactions to this medication are also rare. This is not an exhaustive list of possible side effects. If you are in the United States, contact your doctor for medical advice regarding side effects. Similarly, if you are in Canada, consult your doctor for guidance on side effects. Precautions: Before using epinephrine, inform your doctor or pharmacist if you are allergic to it, to similar bronchodilators (such as albuterol, levalbuterol, or salmeterol), to sympathomimetic drugs (such as pseudoephedrine), or if you have any other allergies. This product may contain inactive ingredients that could cause allergic reactions or other issues. This medication may cause dizziness, and the effects can be exacerbated by alcohol or marijuana (cannabis). Limit your consumption of alcoholic beverages. During pregnancy, this medication should only be used when clearly necessary, and it is unknown whether it passes into breast milk. Drug Interactions: Drug interactions may alter the effectiveness of your medications or increase the risk of serious side effects. This document does not include all possible drug interactions. Maintain a list of all the products you use, including prescription and non-prescription drugs as well as herbal products, and share it with your doctor and pharmacist. Avoid using monoamine oxidase (MAO) inhibitors (such as isocarboxazid, linezolid, methylene blue, moclobemide, phenelzine, procarbazine, rasagiline, safinamide, selegiline, or tranylcypromine) or tricyclic antidepressants (such as amitriptyline or nortriptyline) within two weeks before, during, or after treatment with this medication. Caffeine may increase the side effects of this medication. Overdose: If someone has overdosed and is experiencing serious symptoms such as passing out or difficulty breathing, call 911 immediately. Otherwise, contact a poison control center right away. U.S. residents can call 1-800-222-1222, and Canadian residents can call 1-844-764-7669. Monitoring: Storage: Store this medication at room temperature, away from direct sunlight. Do not puncture the canister or expose it to high heat or open flames. Avoid storing it in the bathroom. Do not flush medications down the toilet or pour them into a drain unless instructed to do so. Properly discard this product when it is expired or no longer needed. Medical Alert: Your condition may cause complications in a medical emergency. Important Information: This document provides a summary and does not include all possible information about this product. It does not guarantee that this product is safe, effective, or appropriate for you. This information is not a substitute for individual medical advice. Always consult your healthcare professional for complete information about this product and your specific health needs.
